project: URUS vs G-CLASS: public-model SUV wind tunnel
ground: y=0 prescribed tangential velocity U=U_in, V=W=0; moving-road approximation
wheels: fixed geometry and zero IBM wall velocity for both vehicles
boundary: uniform +x inlet; convective +x outlet; nonperiodic lateral far field; free-slip top

vehicles.Aref_method: Projected SDF silhouette, identical sampling method for both SUVs

IBM_wall: Existing LICA direct forcing without interpolation; same choice for both coarse-grid vehicle cases
body_interior: Opaque vertical exterior envelope; seal display-model cabin/engine voids connected to open underside. No vehicle internal-flow model.

aero_fuel.force_statistic: Time-weighted mean net drag over the same selected common late window as RMS ranking; do not use RMS for work
aero_fuel.presentation: Minimal ending: winner, drag reduction, model names, approximate aero-only cost and100km. Put assumptions in caption/result files.
